t: This is 221B Baker Street, the London address of Sherlock Holmes. Holmes is fictional, and the address is his, not a real person's. Baker Street was a high-class residential district in the late nineteenth century, and his flat would probably have been part of a Georgian terrace. Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, a writer and physician, created Holmes. He wrote four novels and fifty-six short stories about the detective and his assistant Dr Watson, and these are milestones of crime fiction.
